title: Watercolour part opener
description: Opens a part of the module: the part's number set very large in italic, over a wash of the part's colour, beside the opening's head (the part's title and its lead), then its page.
instructions: The first screen of a section. number: the part's number (1, 2…), the only mark of where the learner is: nothing else goes above or beside the title. The title names the part; lead says what it brings; the body holds one text block with the style meta (what the part holds, in a few words).

number.title: Part number
number.description: The part's number, set very large in italic beside the title (1, 2…).
